content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Distributes MRO supplies through field sales and vendor-managed inventory to manufacturers, matching DXP's MRO distribution and supply services, though test equipment is a side line."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Distributes electronic components and fasteners to electronics OEMs, a different product set and customer base from DXP's plant MRO and pump services."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures welding and cutting equipment and consumables, a different product line and business model from DXP's distribution and repair."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Distributes plumbing and HVAC mainly to contractors and builders, unlike DXP's industrial plant MRO and pump repair customers."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures pumps, valves and seals as an OEM; its aftermarket repair overlaps DXP's services, but its core earnings model is manufacturing."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Makes and reconditions industrial drums and containers and manages timberland, a packaging and land business unlike DXP's MRO distribution."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures pumps, valves, friction products and connectors as an OEM across rail and aerospace, a different model from DXP's distribution."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures papermaking and wood processing equipment as an OEM with installation services, not MRO distribution for plants."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Distributes MRO and industrial supplies to plant maintenance teams with inventory management and tool crib services, closely matching DXP's model and customers."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Designs and manufactures switchgear and substations for power distribution, a different product and project-based business from DXP."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures engines and generator sets sold to equipment OEMs, not distributing MRO products to plants."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Formulates and manufactures specialty chemicals and lubricants as a proprietary brand owner, unlike DXP's third-party MRO distribution."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Delivers propane and heating fuels to households and businesses, a fuel retail and delivery business unlike DXP's industrial MRO distribution."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures pumps for water, fire and petroleum markets as an OEM, not a distributor of pumps and MRO for plants."},{"label":"C15","good":false,"reason":"Rents and launders uniforms and facility supplies on route service, a rental and laundering business rather than product distribution."}]}
